title: TensorPlate Deploy Transaction
description: Durable state record for one in-progress or completed deploy transaction. Owned by `tensorplate-agent` (V01-E08). The state machine is intentionally explicit so a mid-transaction agent restart (V01-E08-T03) can resume from durable state.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier for this transaction. New on every deploy attempt.

state.description: Current state in the transaction lifecycle. Strictly forward-only along the success path; `failed` and `rolled_back` are terminal.

started_monotonic_ns.description: Receiver-monotonic timestamp at which the transaction entered the `received` state.

last_transition_monotonic_ns.description: Receiver-monotonic timestamp of the most-recent state transition.

failure.description: Populated when `state` is `failed` or `rolled_back`. Carries typed reason and recoverability metadata.

recoverable.description: If true, retrying the same transaction is reasonable (transient capacity, reachable bundle store, etc.). If false, the operator must intervene.
